title: flows knowledge-base artefact — the unit of knowledge and work
description: Every row in the KB is an artefact. Types are fixed; statuses and transitions are enforced by the worker, not by callers.

id.description: type-prefixed id, e.g. T#42, D#7, S#3

body_md.description: markdown body; for tasks this is the spec the claimer is accountable to

status.description: per-type; see x-transitions for the legal graph

tags.description: role:* tags gate swimlanes (role:impl, role:analysis, role:review)

owner.description: agent/session holding the exclusive claim — tasks only; null = unclaimed

meta.description: typed extras: kind (impl|analysis|review|research|question) for tasks; ask options for decisions; etc.

x-transitions.description: The only legal status transitions, enforced server-side. Anything outside this graph is rejected with a reason.

progress.x-note: append-only event log; no status, no transitions

agent.x-note: presence/identity record; no status, no transitions

x-task-kinds.description: meta.kind on task artefacts determines pickup mode, output and completion gate.

impl.completion: verify task done (separation of duties; cannot self-verify)

x-invariants.claim: claiming a task requires: status=todo, meta.kind != question, and the session id — owner is set atomically
x-invariants.question: question tasks never hold claims; contributions are progress artefacts with meta.task pointing at the question
x-invariants.sod: the agent that sets a task done cannot be the one that opened the PR it produced — verify tasks close impl tasks
